| `Example-Android/cyltabbar` 是 CYLTabBarController 的 Android 版本（Gradle 模块，Kotlin 与 Java）：按 iOS 的公开 API 一比一翻译，类名、方法名与键名与 iOS 相同（`CYLTabBarController`、`CYLTabBar`、`CYLPlusButton`、`cyl_showBadgeValue`、`CYLTabBarItemTitle` 等），页面为 Fragment（对应 `UIViewController`）。每个 iOS 符号的 Android 对应项、状态与迁移完成率见 [Android API 对照表](Android-API-Map.md)（由 `scripts/android-api-map.py` 生成）。 | `Example-Android/cyltabbar` is CYLTabBarController for Android (a Gradle module, Kotlin and Java): the iOS public API translated one to one, with the iOS class, method and key names (`CYLTabBarController`, `CYLTabBar`, `CYLPlusButton`, `cyl_showBadgeValue`, `CYLTabBarItemTitle`...); pages are Fragments (the iOS `UIViewController`). The Android twin of every iOS symbol, its status and the migration score are in the [Android API map](Android-API-Map.md) (generated by `scripts/android-api-map.py`). |

## [CN]模块
## [EN]Modules

| 模块 Module | 内容 | Contents |
|:---|:---|:---|
| `cyltabbar` | Android 库：`CYLTabBarController`、`CYLTabBar`、`CYLTabBarItem`、`CYLPlusButton` / `CYLPlusButtonSubclassing`、角标（`View.cyl_*` 扩展、`CYLBadgeView`）、`CYLThemeManager` / `CYLTabBarTheme`、`CYLTabBarControllerDelegate`、`CYLTabBarPageRegistry`、`CYLTabBarConfiguration`（配置文件、URL 与值转换）、`CYLConstants`（Java）、`CYLEnums`（Java） | The Android library: `CYLTabBarController`, `CYLTabBar`, `CYLTabBarItem`, `CYLPlusButton` / `CYLPlusButtonSubclassing`, badges (`View.cyl_*` extensions, `CYLBadgeView`), `CYLThemeManager` / `CYLTabBarTheme`, `CYLTabBarControllerDelegate`, `CYLTabBarPageRegistry`, `CYLTabBarConfiguration` (files, URLs and value conversions), `CYLConstants` (Java), `CYLEnums` (Java) |
| `tabpages` | 纯 Kotlin：页面注册表与配置规则（`TabPageRegistry`、`TabConfiguration`、`TabConfigurationFormats`），`cyltabbar` 依赖它 | Pure Kotlin: the page registry and the configuration rules (`TabPageRegistry`, `TabConfiguration`, `TabConfigurationFormats`); `cyltabbar` depends on it |
| `app` | 演示：用 iOS 库自带的配置文件创建 `CYLTabBarController`，PlusButton、角标、点击动画、双击，以及两个 TabBar 共用页面 ID 的场景 | The demo: a `CYLTabBarController` from the iOS library's own configuration file, a plus button, badges, the tap animation, the double tap, and two tab bars sharing page IDs |

## [CN]用法
## [EN]Usage

```kotlin
// [EN] Pages registered by page ID (the same IDs as the iOS demo). [CN] 按页面 ID 注册页面（与 iOS 演示相同的 ID）。
CYLTabBarPageRegistry.sharedRegistry.registerPageProvider({ id, attributes -> HomeFragment() }, "home")
CYLPlusButton.registerPlusButton(MyPlusButton.Provider)          // optional 可选

// [EN] From the iOS library's configuration file (an asset or a path), or from code. [CN] 由 iOS 库的配置文件（asset 或路径）或代码创建。
val controller = CYLTabBarController.tabBarControllerWithConfigurationFile(activity, "cyl_tabbar_configuration.json")
// val controller = CYLTabBarController(activity, listOf(HomeFragment(), MeFragment()), listOf(
//     mapOf(CYLConstants.CYLTabBarItemTitle to "Home", CYLConstants.CYLTabBarItemImage to "home_icon"),
//     mapOf(CYLConstants.CYLTabBarItemTitle to "Me", CYLConstants.CYLTabBarItemImage to "me_icon")))
activity.setContentView(controller.view)

controller.delegate = object : CYLTabBarControllerDelegate {
    override fun tabBarController_didSelectViewController(tabBarController: CYLTabBarController, viewController: Fragment) {}
}
controller.tabBar.tabBarButtonArray[1].cyl_showBadgeValue("12")   // badges 角标
controller.cyl_loginRequiredTabBarItemIdentifiers = listOf("me")  // login (#19) 登录拦截
controller.cyl_tabButtonTapAnimationType = CYLEnums.CYLTabButtonTapAnimationType.Bounce
controller.cyl_themeManager.currentThemeIdentifier = "dark"       // themes (#216) 换肤
```

```java
// [EN] The same API from Java. [CN] Java 中同样的 API。
CYLTabBarController controller = new CYLTabBarController(activity, configuration);
CYLBadgeKt.cyl_showBadgeValue(controller.getTabBar().getTabBarButtonArray().get(0), "3");
```

| 中文 | English |
|:---|:---|
| 图片：配置中的 `"system:house"` 或图片名称通过 `CYLTabBarConfiguration.imageResolver` 解析为 drawable（默认按名称查找 drawable 资源，或文件路径）；演示把 SF Symbol 名称映射到 Android 图标。 | Images: `"system:house"` or an image name in a configuration goes through `CYLTabBarConfiguration.imageResolver` (by default a drawable resource of that name, or a file path); the demo maps the SF Symbol names to Android icons. |
| 页面为 Fragment，由控制器的 `FragmentManager` 以 show / hide 管理，因此切换 Tab 保留页面状态；`selectedIndex`、`viewControllers`、`reloadTabBarItemsWithAttributes`、`replaceViewControllerAtIndex` 与 iOS 相同。 | Pages are Fragments managed by the controller's `FragmentManager` with show / hide, so switching tabs keeps their state; `selectedIndex`, `viewControllers`, `reloadTabBarItemsWithAttributes` and `replaceViewControllerAtIndex` work as on iOS. |
| PlusButton：子类化 `CYLPlusButton`，用一个 `CYLPlusButtonSubclassing` 对象提供 iOS 的类方法（`plusButton`、`indexOfPlusButtonInTabBar`、`multiplierOfTabBarHeight`、`plusChildViewController`、`tabBarContext` 等），`CYLPlusButton.registerPlusButton(provider)` 注册。 | The plus button: subclass `CYLPlusButton` and provide the iOS class methods through a `CYLPlusButtonSubclassing` object (`plusButton`, `indexOfPlusButtonInTabBar`, `multiplierOfTabBarHeight`, `plusChildViewController`, `tabBarContext`...), registered with `CYLPlusButton.registerPlusButton(provider)`. |
| 配置：`CYLTabBarConfiguration` 读取 JSON、XML plist 与 `.properties`（iOS 的其他格式会得到 `UnknownFormat`），按 iOS 规则规范化（平台 / 最低版本排除、重复标识重命名、查找顺序、自动注册开关），并转换 `"{t, l, b, r}"` 边距、`"#RRGGBB"` 颜色、`"bold:15"` 字体与动画键。 | Configurations: `CYLTabBarConfiguration` reads JSON, XML plists and `.properties` (the other iOS formats give `UnknownFormat`), normalizes them with the iOS rules (platform / minimum version exclusion, duplicate identifiers renamed, the lookup order, the automatic flag) and converts `"{t, l, b, r}"` insets, `"#RRGGBB"` colors, `"bold:15"` fonts and the animation keys. |

## [CN]测试
## [EN]Tests

```sh
cd Example-Android
gradle :cyltabbar:testDebugUnitTest   # Robolectric: 10 tests of the controller, badges, plus button, themes, configuration, async pages
gradle :tabpages:test                 # 11 JVM tests of the registry and the configuration rules
gradle :app:assembleDebug             # the demo app (needs the Android SDK)
```

| 中文 | English |
|:---|:---|
| Robolectric 在 JVM 上运行控制器的测试（选中与代理、登录拦截、角标、PlusButton 与子页面、重新加载、主题、共用配置文件与页面注册表、异步页面、TabBar 隐藏与滚动隐藏）。演示 App 只做了编译，**未在设备或模拟器上运行**，因此没有截图。 | Robolectric runs the controller's tests on the JVM (selection and the delegate, login interception, badges, the plus button and its child, reload, themes, the shared configuration file and the page registry, asynchronous pages, hiding the tab bar and scroll hiding). The demo app was only compiled, **not run on a device or an emulator**, so there are no screenshots. |

## [CN]限制
## [EN]Limits

| 中文 | English |
|:---|:---|
| 未移植（对照表中为 planned）：Lottie / PAG / Rive 动画运行库（动画键被读取并保存，但不播放）、自定义点击动画对象（`CYLTabButtonAnimation`）与滑动转场、`UIViewController+CYLTabBarControllerExtention` 的页面辅助方法、列表单元格 / 栏按钮的角标扩展（通用的 `View.cyl_*` 扩展可用于任何视图）、主题的颜色 / 视图扩展。 | Not ported (planned in the map): the Lottie / PAG / Rive animation runtimes (the animation keys are read and kept, not played), custom tap animation objects (`CYLTabButtonAnimation`) and the slide transition, the page helpers of `UIViewController+CYLTabBarControllerExtention`, the badge extensions of list cells / bar buttons (the generic `View.cyl_*` extensions work on any view), the theme color / view extensions. |
| 仅 iOS（对照表中为 n/a）：UIKit 类别、FlatDesign 的 KVC TabBar、液态玻璃、Core Animation、iOS 演示的设置列表与本地化 bundle。 | iOS only (n/a in the map): the UIKit categories, FlatDesign's KVC tab bar, Liquid Glass, Core Animation, the iOS demo's settings list and the localization bundle. |
| 滚动隐藏需要页面调用 `cyl_trackScrollView(view)`（iOS 自动观察滚动视图）；没有“缩小”的 TabBar，只有隐藏 / 显示。 | Scroll hiding needs the page to call `cyl_trackScrollView(view)` (iOS observes the scroll view itself); there is no minimized bar, only hide / show. |
